Data survives session compaction and handover; recalls include `path:line` citation"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"s for source verification."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> The plugin keeps a compact project **memory** on disk, with every entry pointing to a concrete fil"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"e and line — the agent can reorient quickly instead of re-reading the whole project."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **TaskBridge: cross-session development tasks** — the session's todo list and the files it touches"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" are persisted as per-project task entities, so a workflow can be switched and resumed without re-sc"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"oping the project. Associated files stay in recency-weighted order (a read never outranks a written "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"file), so a resumed session sees where to look first. New sessions continue with `list_tasks` → `sel"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ect_task`. Work delegated to subagents creates no task. On hosts without session events the task too"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ls still work as a plain record list.
- **Task panel and editing** — draggable cards show a task's s"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"teps and files, and can collapse to a mini-bar or be hidden. Title, steps and status can be edited i"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"nline, writing back through the same path as model updates; four visual themes change material, geom"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"etry, typeface and density only, and colours follow the host. The panel stays hidden until summoned,"},{"id":"p9s10","text":" syncs in the background on session switch, never reopens itself after a refresh, and a render failu"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"re cannot take down the host.
- **Document memory** — PDF, Markdown and plain text are chunked and s"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"ummarized without a model call. Each entry keeps a short summary for injection, a bounded term set f"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"or recall, and a citation back to the source.
- **Code symbol memory** — a dependency-free scanner e"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"xtracts functions, classes, methods, interfaces and type aliases with signatures; covered languages "},{"id":"p9s15","text":"are JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, C/C++/C#, Java and shell. Where `typescript` is install"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"ed, an optional second layer adds inferred return types, generics and interface shapes; it runs in t"},{"id":"p9s17","text":"he background and never blocks indexing.
- **Automatic, read-time memorization** — with lazy indexin"},{"id":"p9s18","text":"g (default), a file is memorized the moment the model reads it, so memory grows as a byproduct of no"},{"id":"p9s19","text":"rmal work rather than an upfront scan. `index_repo` or a watched root can cover the rest of the tree"},{"id":"p9s20","text":"; a background poll only re-indexes files that changed.
- **Doc ↔ code cross-linking** — a document "},{"id":"p9s21","text":"that mentions a symbol is surfaced when that symbol is queried. Links are resolved against the curre"},{"id":"p9s22","text":"nt symbol table, so they cannot go stale.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The design follows four principles:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Volatility** — context is ephemeral; it is lost when a session is compacted.
- **Persistence** —"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" the **memory** is stored on disk and survives compaction and new sessions.
- **Compactness** — one "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"bounded declaration line per symbol, and a ≤300-char summary plus a bounded term set per document ch"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"unk. Doc→symbol links are not stored; they are computed at read time.
- **Verifiability** — **recall"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"s** carry a `path:line` citation where applicable, so the agent can confirm details against the sour"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" carry a `path:line` citation where applicable, so the agent can confirm details against the source."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"With default lazy indexing, building the **memory** does not require an upfront scan: files are memo"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"rized as the model reads them, so the **memory** grows to cover what has been worked with; `index_re"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"po` or a watched root can cover the rest. Re-reading an unchanged file is a no-op, so the **memory**"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" stays fresh with minimal ongoing overhead."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Project- and task-scope memory is stored per project and follows the codebase: changed files are re-"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"extracted by content hash, deleted files are removed. Experience notes are ordinary `kind: 'experien"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ce'` entries in `insights.json`: recallable, deduplicated, and eligible for the same gated hint chan"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" `insights.json`: recallable, deduplicated, and eligible for the same gated hint channel as lessons."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Architecture (Task Panel)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The workflow panel is collapsible, adapts to dsh and theme plugin styles, and offers four card style"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e workflow panel is collapsible, adapts to dsh and theme plugin styles, and offers four card styles."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Toggling features"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The two most relevant switches are `lazyIndexing` (index a file the moment the model reads it; defau"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"lt on) and `autoIndexOnFirstUse` (full scan of the current working directory on plugin load; default"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" off). Lazily indexed project roots are automatically registered with the watcher, so changed files "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"stay fresh without an explicit `watch_repo`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Root resolution.** In order: an explicit `root` argument; a registered root (`watch_repo`); the ne"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"arest ancestor with a VCS marker (`.git`/`.hg`/`.svn`) or a build/manifest marker (`package.json`, `"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"go.mod`, `Cargo.toml`, `pyproject.toml`, …); the session working directory, unless it is on the excl"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"uded list. A file that matches none of these is not indexed."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"When the root comes from the working directory, the model gets one notice per session naming it and "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"how to change it; mute with `autoContext.rootNotice: false`. Starting dsh in a container directory s"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"uch as `~/workspace` therefore makes that directory the root, and memory spans everything beneath it"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" up to the scan limit — start dsh inside the project for one store per project."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
